about: Recordings available to the game's track mode (docs/TRACK_PACK_FORMAT.md). Metadata only: the audio is other people's music and is never in this repository. 'quick' is a few seconds' look at the whole mix (tempo, loudness, low_share = share of energy below 120 Hz, brightness, events_per_s, blocks_db = level of each 8-bar block relative to the track's loud level, blocks_drive_db = how hard the low end and the hits are going in each block, rough_sections from that drive); it is approximate and its sections are not bar-aligned. 'import' is present once tools/audio_import/import_track.py has been run on the recording, and is measured.
